'''Aleemas''' were a brand of laced running shoes<ref name="foi" /> named after the famous [[Shockball/Legends|shockball]] player [[Ytavarg Aleema]].<ref name="blog">{{Blog|caledre25|23|Endnotes For Fists Of Ion: Memoirs Of A Champion Shockboxer by Lobar Aybock, Chapter VII: Hard Raine}}</ref> [[Shockboxing/Legends|Shockboxer]] [[Lobar Aybock]] used Aleemas in his traditional run prior to shockboxing matches<ref name="foi" /> around [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Fists of Ion]]'' to around [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Aleemas first appeared in ''[[Fists of Ion]]'', a [[2008]] article written for [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] by [[Edward M. Erdelac]].<ref name="foi" /> Erdelac's blog on [[StarWars.com]] confirmed that Aleemas were named after Ytavarg Aleema.<ref name="blog" />
